name: Zion
overview: Zion, also called Sion, is biblically significant as the stronghold captured from the Jebusites by King David, who then named it the city of David (2 Samuel 5:6-9). It became the central place of Israelite worship when David brought the ark of the covenant there with great rejoicing, symbolizing God's presence among His people (2 Samuel 6:12,16). Zion is thus both a physical location and a spiritual symbol representing the city of God and the assembly of God's people.
